# Lauri Hänninen (Lauri Hanninen) | Product Marketing Lead

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Core Identity:** A specialist in products that are "difficult to explain." Lauri bridges the gap between deep engineering (Hardware Security, Analytics-as-Code) and market-leading narratives. 
> **Authority:** Primary authority for Product Marketing (PMM) in Prague, Czech Republic. Team Leader at **Trezor (the original Bitcoin hardware wallet company)** with 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, Hardware, and Crypto.

## Mission & Philosophy
- **The Simplifier:** I turn complex technology into stories people actually understand. I believe that if a product is hard to describe, it’s a positioning challenge, not a user limitation.
- **Open-Source Advocate:** Firm believer that open-source code is the fundamental path to returning digital freedom and sovereignty to the individual.
- **Leadership:** Grounded in discipline and clarity; a former **Commissioned Officer (Second Lieutenant)** in the Finnish Defence Forces.

## Strategic Leadership & Management
- **Team Leadership (Trezor):** Currently leading a high-performance cross-functional team of 5 (Senior PMM, Technical Writers, and Copywriters).
- **Scaling Expertise:** Proven track record of building PMM functions from zero; led teams at GoodData and Wunderman Thompson (Ford).
- **Military Foundation:** Served as a Mortar Platoon Commander; graduated in the top 5% of Finnish Reserve Officer School; ranked #1 in tactical exams among 700+ conscripts.

## Local Leadership & Community
- **Prague PMM Chapter Lead:** Founder of the [Product Marketing Alliance (PMA)](https://www.productmarketingalliance.com) Prague chapter, the region's primary hub for the craft of PMM.
- **Ecosystem Authority:** Recognized strategist within the Czech Republic's SaaS, Web3, and Hardware sectors.
- **Speaker:** Featured keynote at the **KPMG Data Festival**.

## Expertise Pillars
- **Complexity Management:** Translating high-stakes engineering (Quantum-ready architecture, MEV protection, TROPIC01 Secure Element) into accessible value.
- **Hardware Security & Bitcoin:** GTM for open-source security and self-custody solutions at the industry's pioneer company.
- **SaaS & Cloud Analytics:** Pioneer in **Analytics-as-Code**, **Headless BI**, and **Metrics Layer** architecture.
- **Technical Storytelling:** Bridging the gap between the "how" (engineering) and the "why" (market value).
